materialization_policy: Keep active move IDs compact. Do not jump into the high u16 space merely to separate categories; Platinum indexes and preloads move data by numeric ID.

ranges.name: official_canonical
ranges.purpose: Official Pokémon moves. IDs 1-919 cover the pinned Gen 1-9 canonical set after removing HG-Engine's three dummy slots. Future official moves stay in this lane.

ranges.name: community_imports
ranges.purpose: Reusable fan-made/community moves imported into Mercury with provenance and compatibility metadata.

ranges.name: mercury_custom
ranges.purpose: Original Mercury Redux moves intended for normal player or trainer use.

ranges.name: boss_variant_signature
ranges.purpose: Boss, Mega, Delta, event, alternate-form, and other signature moves.

ranges.name: experimental_staging
ranges.purpose: Development-only or provisional move IDs. Content must graduate to a permanent lane before a sealed release.

ranges.name: inactive_future_space
ranges.purpose: Architecturally valid u16 space but intentionally not materialized on DS without a separate memory/table audit.

donor_id_note: Pinned HG-Engine keeps three HGSS dummy slots at 468-470, so its modern move IDs are +3 versus canonical main-series IDs. Mercury drops those dummies when importing.
